verdict.rationale: Codegen can analyze requirements and create/update tasks in Jira, Linear, Clickup, and Monday.com, which is loosely related to turning input into structured tasks, but there is no evidence of a feature specifically for ingesting 'user feedback submissions' or producing a 'proposed scope' artifact. missing for 10: dedicated feedback-intake workflow, structured scope/spec output format, PM-facing triage UI or examples showing feedback-to-task conversion.
